scenarios.name: Successful login with valid credentials navigates to dashboard
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user enters a valid email and correct password
the user clicks the submit button
then: the user is redirected to the dashboard

scenarios.name: Login blocked and authentication error shown for incorrect password
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user enters a valid email and an incorrect password
the user clicks the submit button
then: the user remains on the login page
an authentication error message is displayed

scenarios.name: Login blocked and required field errors shown when both fields are empty
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user leaves both email and password fields empty
the user clicks the submit button
then: required field validation errors are shown for both email and password fields

scenarios.name: Login blocked and required field error shown when password is empty
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user enters a valid email and leaves the password field empty
the user clicks the submit button
then: a required field error is shown for the password field only

scenarios.name: Login blocked and email format error shown for invalid email format
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user enters an invalid email format and a valid password
the user clicks the submit button
then: an email format validation error is displayed

test_data.expected_error: Please enter a valid email address

scenarios.name: Login blocked and required field error shown when only email is empty
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user leaves the email field empty and enters a valid password
the user clicks the submit button
then: a required field error is shown for the email field only

scenarios.name: Account lockout message shown after multiple consecutive failed login attempts
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user submits invalid credentials five consecutive times
then: a lockout warning message is displayed to the user

test_data.expected_message: Account temporarily locked due to multiple failed attempts

scenarios.name: Login form fields and submit button are keyboard navigable and screen-reader accessible
given: the user is on the login page
when: the user navigates the form using only the keyboard Tab and Enter keys
then: the email field, password field, and submit button are reachable via Tab
ARIA labels and roles are present on all form controls
form submission is possible using the Enter key
